purpose: Declare ordinary JSON item text once and display it using the current game locale without changing stable item IDs or player-authored names.

resolver.order: current locale CSV key -> English CSV key -> inline LocalizedItemText -> existing literal field
resolver.acceptedLocales: Official locale files: en, fr, de, ru, zh, ja, es, ptBR, ko, it. Runtime codes zh-CN/zh-TW select Chinese; pt-BR and pt_BR resolve the ptBR table.
resolver.keyRule: Every referenced content-pack key must exist in Localization/en.csv. Fixed item fields do not accept format placeholders.
resolver.ownership: A CSV-bound item field needs modId and resolves only through that owner's accepted content-pack catalog.

fields.native: official late tooltip callback; avoids storing creation-language text
official tooltip label; live tag value stays separate
PixelWindow title at creation and reopen refresh

lifecycle.refreshScope: Only EZapi JSON/DLL items whose directory application state is Applied. No global inventory scan or native object cache.
lifecycle.nameOwnership: Updates a framework-generated name only; custom player names, item identifiers, tags and foreign item objects are preserved.
lifecycle.buildGate: Since0.1.87 no whole-wrapper-DLL SHA gate. Initialized game main thread plus NativeHookGroup exact signatures, native executable entries and patch-owner checks; independently reports readiness.

optionalDllDescriptions.empty: Explicit empty string clears the selected description at creation and every refresh.
optionalDllDescriptions.missing: A missing language falls back to the other; both null supply no override and preserve the existing factory/restored field.
optionalDllDescriptions.limits: 4000 characters per provided translation; names and sources still require readable nonblank text.
optionalDllDescriptions.implementation: Inline registered values use the same ForLocale route at factory creation and refresh. Generic readable Resolve and JSON/CSV declaration validation retain their stricter contracts.
